description: This file implements a watchdog timer driver for Infineon CAT1 hardware within the Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, configuration, interrupt handling, and control functions.

methods.name: ifx_cat1_wdt_isr_handler
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for the watchdog timer, calls callback if registered and masks the interrupt.

methods.name: ifx_cat1_wdt_setup
methods.description: Initializes the watchdog timer with specified options.

methods.name: ifx_cat1_wdt_disable
methods.description: Disables the watchdog timer and masks its interrupt.

methods.name: ifx_cat1_wdt_install_timeout
methods.description: Installs a timeout configuration for the watchdog timer.

methods.name: ifx_cat1_wdt_feed
methods.description: Feeds (kicks) the watchdog timer to prevent it from resetting.

methods.name: ifx_cat1_wdt_init
methods.description: Initializes the watchdog device, including setting up interrupt connection if enabled.
